derivation.rationale: The rig routinely inspects which marketing tags a live page carries (CHANEL GB/FR/US via authenticated Chrome, and public sites). The capability is the same on any site; only the page differs.
varied: target page: a different public retail homepage
tag container: two GTM containers (GTM-5WWF665, GTM-TSWKBGX3) rather than one

deterministic_evidence.detail: tag truth is recomputed from the live DOM at verify time

instruction: Open the PUMA UK homepage. Inspect the LIVE page (page HTML, script tags, window globals) for marketing tags, then record your finding by setting window.__bench_finding with ONE eval to a JSON object with exactly these keys: {"gtm": [every GTM container id found anywhere in the page, each matching /GTM-[A-Z0-9]+/], "aw": [every Google Ads id matching /AW-[0-9]{6,}/], "pinterest": true if a Pinterest tag is present (window.pintrk is defined, or a ct.pinterest.com / pintrk reference exists), else false}. Do not change the page. Finish only after window.__bench_finding is set.
objective: On the live PUMA UK homepage, record which marketing tags the page actually carries: the GTM container id set, Google Ads (AW-) ids and Pinterest tag presence.

pre_state.detail: navigate to the public homepage in a fresh browser context; no account, no login, no prior state

provenance.verified_against: window.__bench_finding matches the independently recomputed tag ground truth for the live page (GTM container id set, Google Ads AW- id set, Pinterest presence)

raw_task_statement: please complete the production QA of the google ads tags ... ideally we want to confirm every tag is working ... I have all the relevant chanel website tabs open in my omc chrome profile ... please connect to it and use playwriter to complete the QA

verification.description: Independent recomputation of the tag ground truth from the live page, compared to the agent's window.__bench_finding.
